balls.text: and what a way to finish, another length ball, and flicked over midwicket, not much back lift, no follow through, sweet timing, RP has been dismantled in this over
length ball, Kohli goes leg side, gets a leading edge, but no one wants to catch the skier at cover, neither Ojha from mid-off nor Harris from sweeper-cover
Kohli joins the party, this is short, because he is not reputed to play the bouncer well, but he rocks back and pulls it sweetly over midwicket
back of  a length, makes room, and slashes it through the covers, will be only one
oh boss, even Gibbs can't do anything about it, this is another length ball, and he has smoked it down the ground, over Gibbs
shot, this is absolutely smoked down the ground, length ball, and hit powerfully, but Gibbs is too good at long-on, dives and saves four
yorker, outside off, and plays it down towards mid-off
another good bouncer, surprises Pandey who walks down the wicket, and pulls with one hand off the bat
goes for the bouncer, tucks him up, he misses the pull, but gets a leg-bye
length ball again, on off stump, played across the line, into the cow's corner for two
full, outside off, makes room, and plays with an open face towards sweeper-cover
length ball, outside off, and driven down to long-off

there it is, gets a two to wide of long-on, an unlikely centurion, the first Indian to do so in all IPL matches. An unlikely opener first of all, but what an innings - he has slogged merrily, he has also played some smart cricket. More importantly he has rode his luck. Take a bow Pandey
nerves boys, just outside off, back of a length, looks to dab it for one, doesn't beat gully
again back of a length, on pads, and played down to long-on
back of a length, outside off, and played towards cover
he will take a single to get to 99, flicked away from in front of middle, towards deep midwicket
on the pads, back of a length, turned to backward square leg
RP takes a catch this time, Taylor tries his slog-sweep, he has been tied down all over, and he gets a top edge towards deep midwicket, where RP doesn't make a mistake
yorker outside off, and beats Taylor, good over
just short of a diving Rohit Sharma at pint, got a thick edge from Taylor with a big turner
gets hold of his nerves, pitched up on the pads, and he turns away into the leg side
and is beaten on the forward defensive by a slow turner
on the stumps, turning away, and worked away for single
shot, but can't beat point, short on the stumps, creates room and cuts
it's been that kind of day, thrown up outside off, Pandey clears the front leg again, throws a mighty kitchen sink at it, and the edge beats the keeper
back of a length, slogs again, and misses, it's been that kind of day
that's a big six that takes him to nineties, length ball, clears his leg again, gets under it, and clears long-on with ease
shot! top shot! short, over the top of stumps, Pandey makes room, opens the face, and beats short third man, perhaps the first time he has gone behind square on purpose
length ball, outside off, Pandey mishits, which is just as well, because that allows him get two to long-on
on the pads, turned around the corner for one
the semi-sweep-semi-flick again, picks it from outside off, and places it wide of midwicket, what a shot, hoe he has improved during this innings

this is a superb shot, because this ball dips big time, from looking like a fulltoss it becomes a length ball, and instead of his initial shape to go midwicket, Pandey goes straight down the ground, and gets the power to beat long-on
thrown up again, around off stump, and played straight towards cover
caught in tow minds, is Dravid, this one is flighted, Dravid clears his leg, wants to slog-sweep, but at the last moment goes straight, gets a top-edge, and it is skied to long-off
Ojha throws it up generously, Pandey waits, delays the shot, makes room, and carves it through the off side
fulltoss, dragged from outside off, to long-on for one
length ball, on the leg stump, and slogs again, but finds midwicket
Pandey clears his front leg again, and throws his bat again, and gets a thick outside edge for four, moves into seventies
short, angling across, doesn't come on fast enough, so the cut shot goes a bit awry, but he gets one to cover
makes room, RP bowls a slow offcutter, wide of off stump, and Pandey still throws his bat at it, and gets a single at sweeper-cover
shot, RP digs it in short, Pandey clears his front leg, and finds the gap between mid-on and midwicket. Flat-batted that was
makes room, flat-bats a fulltoss, lucky for him it doesn't carry to long-off
yorker, played back to the bowler
short, on the stumps, Dravid makes room for the cut, but this comes on slowly, but he goes aerial and clears the in field
angling into the pads again, and a single to deep midwicket
back of a length, on the pads, flicked away into the on side
length ball, Pandey makes room, and slashes through the off side

finally Pandey's trademark semi-flick-semi-sweep comes out, clears the front leg, shapes for the sweep, but doesn't really go down all the way, and flicks it towards midwicket. He plays that shot often in domestic cricket
smart shot, short, he waits for the ball, and then places it to wide of sweeper-cover
clears his front leg, flat-bats it down to wide of long-off
short again, and he rocks back, and goes sweeper-cover
shortish, spinning away, and cut away towards sweeper-cover
thrown up, Dravid gets on the front foot, and flicked wristily
round the wicket now, cramps him up on the leg stump, played back to the bowler
goes over extra cover this time, nice chip shot, gets two before the long-off comes around
brings up his 50 with another slog, flat one this time, perfect shot, in his zone, and another slog-sweep for six
finally he gets the slog right, this was in his zone, good length, middle stump, he slog-sweeps over cow's corner, smooth six
back of a length, Pandey shapes for the slog again, and hits towards deep midwicket again, and Dravid does well to take this quick second, initiated by Pandey
thrown up gently, on the pads, flicked away towards deep midwicket and they will get two
back of a length, outside off, punched away wide of cover for one
angling into the pads, and glanced away nicely towards fine leg
wide, length ball, Dravid leans into it and drives, but straight to cover
back of a length, nipping in, and turned away towards square leg

smart stumping from Gilchrist. van der Merwe looks for the slog again, is beaten by the extra bounce, the momentum into the shot carries his front foot outside, and Gilchrist is alert and removes the bails before he can come back in. An amusing little innings
short and wide, and cut away through covers
steps out again, Jaskaran sees him coming, and goes for his wide yorker, which works this time
goes for the leg-side yorker, it's  a touch short, and is played easily towards deep backward square
length ball, shaping in, Pandey clears his front leg and slogs, and gets it all along the ground, towards deep midwicket
sees Pandey move away, goes for the wide yorker, and goes too wide
makes room, Jaskaran goes short, and Pandey pulls towards midwicket
looks to walk down the pitch, sends a telegram to the bowler before he does so, Jaskaran goes for a wide yorker, and beats him
short, on the stumps, Pandey makes room and slashes, and beats the cover field
forward defensive - oh my god, van der Merwe is doing everything
and he clears the leg-side field next ball, steps out, gets to the pitch, his head and the shot look in the same direction - over midwicket, big six
goes for the slog next ball, this is slow again, and he gets a bottom edge
superb shot from van der Merwe now, steps out, gets to the pitch, and goes inside-out, lovely flat hit over extra cover
goes for the slog Pandey, Ojha slows it down, and beats him in the flight, bottom edge gets him one
short, pitches off, turns away, and van der Merwe cuts straight to sweeper-cover
premeditates, backs away, Jas gets it short, some pace this time, 130ks, and beats the slash from Pandey
wastes a half-volley, middle-stop half-volley, and he looks to take the leather off it, but hits straight to mid-off
pitches it up, Pandey is looking for the big drive, but it stops on him, and he defends it towards mid-off
short again, 128ks, and Pandey slashes it through the off side, finds the gap between point and cover
short again, no pace, and Pandey picks out cover this time
short and wide, 121ks, and punched away off the back foot, easy pickings
back of a length, jagging back towards off stump, and no room, so just a single down to long-on
back of a length, outside off, and punched away towards cover
delays the release of the ball this time, like offspinners, the ball jags in from outside off and defended
angled into the pads, and played towards midwicket
slogged away again, clearing the front leg, and swatted away towards backward square leg
short, wide and and seaming in, van der Merwe cuts hard, but can't beat Gibbs
another miscue that just about clears the infield. Pandey looks to make room, Harris goes short, the ball gets big, and takes the top edge and clears mid-on
typical van der Merwe again, clears his front leg, his head falls to the leg side, gets a thick outside edge that lobs towards third man
steps out, makes room, looks for the pull, and gets the bottom edge again
goes for the pull, and is clearly late into the shot, 138ks, and gets big from just back of a length
good quick single, played with soft hands, towards mid-on, and the call is immediate
this time Pandey does a van der Merwe, steps down, looks to go leg side, gets a thick edge that lobs over cover

this is the best shot of the lot, a leg-sdie half-volley, swinging in late, he gets the bat down in time, flicking it into the gap between mid-on and midwicket. It actually was the similar delivery to the one that got Kallis, but VDM got it along the ground and through the gap
this time he steps down, and the head and the ball go same direction, clearing mid-on easily, good shot
that's a van der Merwe special, a pitched-up delivery, VDM's head looks leg side, the shot goes off side, over extra, for two
on target, pitches middle, shapes in a touch, defended back to the bowler
short and angling across van der Merwe, he edges it, the bottom edge, so it bounces in front of Gilchrist
over-pitched, driven straight down to mid-off
played straight to Gibbs at point, van der Merwe wants a quick single, but has to rush back quickly after having taken just two steps
lets this one go outside off, good carry there
flicked away from in front of stumps, and RP is kicking the ground - Sympathy for the Devil. Superb shot, though this one, between mid-on and midwicket

Oh My God! RP has got all the help from his fielders, and drops a sitter here, loses the ball in the background at third man. This was upper-cut, a lolly to RP at third man, and he lets it go through, suggesting he couldn't see the ball
looks to make room, Harris follows him, he plays leg side, but can't beat midwicket
back of a length again, outside off, and defended

soft dismissal, Kallis will say; we had a fielder there, Deccan will say. a leg-stump half-volley, swinging in, Kallis flicks it, thinks it's four, and then he sees T Suman at short square leg take an easy catch. No. 20 for RP
good-looking shot, hits a length ball straight down the ground, but can't beat mid-off
this one doesn't swing, pitches a bit outside leg, and goes straight, Kallis misses out as he goes for the big leg-side hit
swing again, length ball, shaping in from around off stump, and played down to mid-off
back of a length, angled across, and punched away backward of square for two
throws it up, a little bit of swing, and defended outside off
bowling, superb bouncer, gets big on Kallis, just outside off, angling in, making him fend, and then leaving him as it passes the stumps
short again, this time Pandey finds the gap between gully and point, Sharma and Gibbs
tries a short one, Pandey plays with an open face, towards Sharma at gully
a bit of swing, wide outside off, pitched up, Pandey drives without feet, and misses
back of a length, outside off, defended off the back foot
bread and butter for Kallis first ball, length ball, on the pads, flicked away towards deep backward square, where Ojha makes a tumbling save, running in from fine leg
full and straight, and incredibly Bangalore have finished third
off a short run, gets an inside edge into the ground, which bounces over the keeper's head
yorker on leg, and that's it, only wides and extras can win Deccan this game
full, on the pads, and flicked into the leg side, finds the gap but not the boundary
extravagant footwork, extravagant shot, moves across the stumps, leaves all three sticks exposed, and flicks it over short fine
yorker from PK, hit softly towards long-off, lack of pace on the shot means they can get two
good ball, short and fired into him, Harris makes room and wafts and misses. Boucher makes a stumping, but replays show he is in comfortably
pitched up, outside off, and driven through to wide of extra cover
good shot, back of a length, Bilakhia makes room and hits it over cover and finds the gap
flighted outside off, makes room, and smashes it down to long-off
pitched up on the leg stump, swept away towards short fine

Kohli is cooler than Sharma. Low fulltoss from Kumble, Sharma tries to clear long-on, doesn't middle, Kohli nonchalantly stations himself at the boundary, and takes it over his head. Doesn't move, doesn't emote. Like it's everyday business
pitched up on the pads, and Sharma makes room and flicks it in the air towards deep backward square, Taylor does the fielding
beats Rao outside off, Sharma wants the strike, Rao has to run for the bye, and Boucher underarms it perfectly to Kumar who finds Rao short
good bowling, sees Rao move away, and throws it full and wide, and beats him
slower ball, Sharma makes room, opens the face towards short third, but they take a single after a fumble from Uthappa
shot, cool Sharma plays a cool scoop shot, this was another yorker gone wrong by just being a touch shorter than one, he walks in front of his stumps, and flicks it over short fine leg
goes for the yorker, it's a low fulltoss, which he plays down to long-on
good over, six singles only, the last one of which is dabbed towards point
looks for the pull, mis-hits, but this one doesn't carry as far as long-on
dropped, a harsh call but dropped still, he looks to make room for the cut, but is cramped for room and gets a thick edge, so very difficult for Boucher to hold on to
slower ball, on a length, Sharma makes room, but loses his shape and can hit only to long-on
stays short again, on the stumps, and he turns it into the on side for another single
back of a length, Rohit looks to slog, gets the bottom part of the bat for one into the leg side
back of a length, on the middle stump, and he dabs it into the on side for an easy single
angled into the pads, and he turns it down towards midwicket
steps out, hits powerfully to wide of long-off, and they run fast for two
pitched up on the leg stump, and played down to long-on
throws it up this time, Venu drops it down for one into the off side
and that's a big big wicket that he has got, pitched full, arm ball, Symonds goes for the slog-sweep, plays all over it and the off stump goes out of the ground
another dot delivery, he moves quickly to his right to field this solid drive
back of a length, outside off, and he looks to run it down to third man, but can't beat the short third man
strays on to the pads, and he turns it around the corner for one
keeps it back of a length again, just outside off, and Sharma defends it into the off side
back of a length, outside off, punched away through the covers

and he gets a wicket in the first over of his spell again, Gibbs looks to pull off the front foot, doesn't connect, gets one hand off, and top-edges it into the on side, where Pandey, running in from deep backward square leg, holds on to it
one more dot ball, no room for Gibbs outside off, and this is just back of a length, and Gibbs plays it straight towards point
lest you think it's a drop again by Uthappa, this was a bump ball, a yorker played into the ground and then towards point
back of a length, and played down the ground for one
beware the man dropped for the Ashes, length ball, on the pads, and he has smoked it over long-on, again no need of big back lift or followthrough, pure timing
pitched up on the pads, and he gets an easy single to deep backward square
back of a length, and Gibbs flat-bats it straight down the ground, they will get an easy two
arm ball again, Gibbs makes room, but is cramped with the angle, and still manages a single to short third man
pitched up, and he takes a single to cover
and just like that, he brings out a straight loft, a jab really that lands enough to the right of long-off
thrown up outside off, slight bite off the surface, and defended
goes flat again, but down the leg side
thrown up slower, Symonds looks to turn off the pads, but the bat turns too early
good arm ball, on the stumps, hurries up after pitching, defended back
back of a length, and pulled to deep backward square leg
full, on the pads, and hit to long-on
on the pads, and takes a single to wide of short fine leg
looks to turn to leg, but is beaten by inward movement, but it goes down the leg side
skids off from back of a length, hurried into the shot and hits straight to cover
and it's official now - both the teams have made it to semis, on the pads it was, and he played to wide of long-on and they get two
pitched up, outside off and played down to long-off
soft dismissal, short ball, hit straight to van der Merwe at cover, he was looking to blast the leather of the ball, and was hurried a bit too by the skid
googly with extra bounce, Gibbs looks to cut, and is beaten by both - and gets an outside edge for one
pitches it up now, and drives it down the ground
nice shot, this is short, skidding onto the stumps, Suman makes room and crashes it square of third man
thrown up, and played straight towards cover
starts off with a quick delivery over the stumps, beats him on the cut
just back of a length, outside off, and a single to sweeper-cover
good running, this is hit just to the left of long-on, and Gibbs calls early and comes back for two
pitched up, and helped away for a single down to long-on
big shout, Gibbs goes across to sweep him, is hit in front of the middle stump, but perhaps the umpire thinks it is going down leg. Hawkeye says it was hitting leg
hurries him with a sharp delivery, angling in and he lofts it towards long-on, no damage done
nice, back of a length, breaking in, and played towards wide long-on
starts off with a wide down the leg side, another good take by Boucher
he finally gets to his 50, back of a length, and he hits it towards long-on
slower ball, some nine metres wide outside off stump, Boucher does well to dive an prevent further damage

Uthappa drops another sitter, he has stood up and hit this straight into the air towards long-on, and Uthappa drops this one in front of his eyes. And Gibbs has already started walking back, doesn't even take single
slower ball, he has almost pulled twice this short one, and in the end cues it to third man
pulled off the front foot again, towards deep backward square
looks to sweep the medium-pacer, Akhil bowls it short, and beats the shot
good-looking shot, Suman steps out and drives inside-out, but Kohli does well at short extra-cover
thrown up, and an easy single down to long-on
almost an LB, this is the arm ball, stays low too, but Suman gets his bat down in time
down the leg side, Gibbs goes for the sweep, but misses yet gets a leg-bye
thrown up this time, low trajectory, and gets a single to long-on
angles that into the pads, Gibbs stands back and plays it down to fine leg
length ball, outside off, and Gibbs opens the face towards third man

and Gilchrist is gone, on the pull shot - hard to believe as it is, but once again the extra bounce troubles Gilchrist, who gets a top edge that lobs towards deep backward square, where van der Merwe takes a safe running catch
short again, and Gilchrist pulls it savagely, but Taylor at deep midwicket makes a diving save and keeps them down to two
pulled off the front foot, but straight towards deep backward square
length ball on the pads, and played down the ground for one
short and wide, Gilchrist misses out. Perhaps surprised by the extra bounce
floats it up outside off and Gibbs defends off the back foot
now he just has to get aside and watch the flatter ball slide well down leg stump for a wide
even better, dances down and lofts the ball effortlessly over long-off
one, two and six! Gibbs two-steps down and collects this one on the full and drives flat over mid-on for half a dozen
well then thats just beaten everyone! Gibbs jumps back to the sixth stump to try and go over the off side but Roelof follows him with an arm ball, much slower, which then beats Boucher as well
flat still, much shorter, and Gilchrist works it down to mid-on and a hard throw comes back to sting Roelof's fingers ... ouch
starts off flat down the pads so Gibbs tucks him through square
slower ball pitches outside leg stump, Gilchrist tries to work it very fine but doesn't connect well and Boucher reacts well to stop the ball
terrible over! This time its a low full toss put away through extra cover
now he errs down Gilchrist's pads, serving it up full and wide, Gilchrist cannot connect and Boucher has work to do to his right to prevent further damage
full down leg stump again and he laps it down to the man at deep fine
oh man this guy's looking good this evening! Now he just walks across and laps that with excellent bat speed, cocks the wrists and picks the gap at short fine leg
steps out, PK holds back the length but Gibbs it too good, crashing that one off the pads for six more over square leg
bad ball from PK and is been dispatched via a short-arm flick, poor full ball down leg stump and in a jiffy Gibbs gets the wrists into play, sending it sailing over square leg
topspinner, invites a pull from Gibbs, but this one speeds upon pitching, getting through to his pads long before he expects
googly, thrown up too, and Gilchrist clears the front leg and sweeps against the turn, but there is deep midwicket in place
short again, Gilchrist looks to cut, but doesn't have the room to do so, and plays straight to cover
steps out, it is quicker and flatter, and he plays it towards midwicket
he has lofted this length bowl towards cow's corner, superb shot
length ball, on the pads, and played straight back to the bowler
goes for the yorker, but this is a half-volley on the pads, and Gibbs misses out on it - gets a leg-bye
slower ball, just outside off, but a bit too short, no false shot here, but straight to cover
back of a length, shaping away from the off stump, and punched into the off side
short again, and Gibbs stands in the crease and pulls to wide of midwicket
Gibbs steps out, PK doesn't bowl full, and he defends it into the off side
short, on the stumps, Gilchrist leans back and upper-cuts, gets one to wide of third man
another short delivery, not giving him much room, but he manages to get one third man
back of a length, angling across, and Gilchrist stands tall and defended
no feet again, this is wide of off stump, and Gibbs hangs his bat out, and gets a thick outside edge
back of a length, angling in, Gibbs stands on the crease and pokes, and gets two into the leg side
shot, into the body, but doesn't rise this time, Gibbs stands tall and pulls, clears the in field easily
good bounce, back of a length, and jumping, and Gibbs misses on the defensive shot
flat delivery, on the pads, and turned away towards midwicket
googly perhaps, thrown up, moves from Gilchrist, who cuts it straight to point
good comeback, pushes it through, Gilchrist goes for the cut, and is beaten by the extra bounce
the agenda has been set, steps out, lofts him over mid-on, clean swing of the bat
thrown up on the stumps, played back to the bowler
pushed through by Kumble, angling across, and punched through to cover
